title: Trump defends 'fantastic' ties with Xi, Putin after summit backlash
summary: WASHINGTON — US President Donald Trump on Friday defended his “momentous” summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin as he returned home from China to face bitter criticism and turmoil…

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — US President Donald Trump on Friday defended his “momentous” summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin as he returned home from China to face bitter criticism and turmoil after the midterm elections. Speaking at a news conference in the White House the day after flying back, Trump said his “fantastic relationships” with the Chinese and Russian leaders helped keep the United States secure. Trump particularly defended his ties to Putin after controversially callin him “my friend” when they met in Shenzhen — and insisted that the Kremlin boss genuinely wanted to end Russia’s war in Ukraine.
